inlines.v: LITIG'IOUS, adjective [Latin litigiosus.] 1. Inclined to judicial contest; given to the practice of contending in law; quarrelsome; contentious; applied to persons. a litigious man is a bad neighbor and a bad citizen. 2. Disputable; controvertible; subject to contention; as litigious right. No fences, parted fields, nor marks nor bounds, distinguish'd acres of litigious grounds.
